summary.zh: 查询供应商未清项目与付款状态，并用可解释规则识别重复、冻结、异常账户和逾期风险。
summary.en: Checks vendor open items and payment status, then explains duplicate, block, bank-account and overdue risks.

zh: 查询基准日或日期范围
只读查询，不执行付款或清账
计划付款不等同于已清账
en: Read-only; never pays or clears items
Scheduled payment is not reported as cleared

description.zh: 识别到期、未清、发票状态或风险检查意图，并抽取供应商、公司代码、凭证和日期范围。
description.en: Classifies due-date, open-item, invoice-status or risk intent and extracts scope.

purpose.zh: 确定性意图和参数抽取

description.zh: 通过可替换的只读端口获取未清、已清、付款运行和主数据。
description.en: Loads open, cleared, payment-run and master data through a replaceable read-only port.

purpose.en: Isolates RFC, OData, CDS or fixtures

purpose.zh: 人工核对未清项、付款运行和凭证
purpose.en: Human verification of open items, payment runs and documents

description.zh: 区分未清、已计划、已付款和已清账，避免把付款运行误报为最终付款。
description.en: Separates open, scheduled, paid and cleared states without overstating payment-run evidence.

purpose.zh: 范围校验、查询编排和状态聚合
purpose.en: Scope validation, query orchestration and status aggregation

description.zh: 检查重复参考号、重复金额、付款冻结、异常银行账户和逾期。
description.en: Checks duplicate references, duplicate amounts, blocks, unusual bank data and overdue items.

purpose.zh: 产生可追踪规则编号、证据和建议
purpose.en: Produces traceable rule IDs, evidence and recommendations

description.zh: 返回按币种汇总、项目、风险和数据追踪，并保留机器可读 JSON。
description.en: Returns currency-aware summaries, items, risks and lineage as business text and JSON.

purpose.zh: 结构化 JSON 与中文业务摘要
